sample.source: Private previously saved project. Not uploaded to the repository; no fresh map download.

syntheticStraightEdge.method: Synthetic diagonal major road. Intersect the printed mesh at 25% of its profile height; compare perpendicular distances to its centerline inside the central 50 mm. Max minus min, not a manufacturing tolerance.

limitations: Geometry improvement, not an edit to source map coordinates. Protected building contacts and thin slivers are not subdivided. Additional vertices increase file size; no performance guarantee or physical print test.
